messages.subject: centering axis title & legend at the bottom (according to grid not to the whole plot)
parts:
dear list members

i've got 2 questions:

A)

any news about the issue of centering axis titles according to the
grey grid and not the whole width of the plot?

threads:

http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/86e6e831b149db/6c5419340d308e34?lnk=gst&q=label+center#6c5419340d308e34

or

https://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/838b61677a63ed20/7c97cd502a1128cd?lnk=gst&q=Update+on+an+old+(%3F)+problem%3A+Centering+labels+#7c97cd502a1128cd

??


B) i would like to center my legends in the bottom according to the
grey grid too

my example:

library (ggplot2)


activities <- c("drinking Beer","drinking Beer","drinking
tea","drinking tea","eating bread", "eating bread", "having fun and
doing nothing","having fun and doing nothing")
values <- c(76,12,43,12,21,18,100,96)
gender <- c("girl","boy","girl","boy","girl","boy","girl","boy")
d <- data.frame (activities,values,gender)


p <- ggplot(d,aes(activities, values, fill=gender))
p <- p + geom_bar (position="dodge")
p <- p + coord_flip ()
p <- p + opts(legend.direction = "horizontal", legend.position =
"bottom")
p <- p + scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(from=0,to=100,by=10))
p

any ideas to center the legend "gender" according the grey grid (under
the value "50" of the x-axis)? (automatically not manually)

thanks! greg
